|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ストームトルーパー専用のブラス・テックＥ－１１ブラスター・ライフル。銃床は折り畳式で、ピストルとしてもライフルとしても使える。装弾数は100発で、軍用に限定される。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Blaster Rifle.

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on a warrior character. Use 2 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny +1 > ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny +1 > maneuver or armor.

'''Lore:''' A stormtrooper-issue BlasTech E-11 blaster rifle. The stock folds so it can be used as a pistol or a rifle. It holds 100 shots and is limited to military use.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Hit checks use ability, maneuver or armor; the English uses defense value.
